🎥🎬: Lanterns

Hal Jordan, one of the most legendary Green Lanterns, is paired with John Stewart, a younger recruit who is still learning what it means to carry the responsibility of a Green Lantern. Their partnership quickly becomes complicated as their very different personalities and approaches to justice collide.

The two Lanterns are drawn into a dark investigation involving a mysterious murder in the American heartland. What initially appears to be a local case soon reveals connections to a much larger threat, forcing Hal and John to confront secrets that reach beyond Earth.

As they follow the clues, the series explores the mythology of the Green Lantern Corps while building a grounded cosmic detective story about duty, trust, and the burden of wielding incredible power.
